family_reports.body: Family Court is nothing but an extortion ring filled with corrupt court actors lining their pockets at the cost of children. Biggest child trafficking agency in the world. Children left traumatized over and over again while stable loving parents loose everything.
The system has traumatized my family while allowing the abuser to lie, conceal assets, dismantle a business, and still be awarded over $100,000 in attorney’s fees.
